versions.content: The detection of an incomplete write operation to a NV block is out of scope of the NvM module. This is handled and detected by the memory hardware abstraction. The NvM mod ule expects to get information from the memory hardware abstraction if a referenced NV block is invalid or inconsistent and cannot be read when requested. SW - Cs may use NvM_InvalidateNvBlock to prevent lower layers from delivering old data.
